The PAIRP bug extends to EE. This broke ULisp rather badly. Please be aware
that there are many students depending on Maclisp and Maclisp-based systems
working on EE. I have patched ULisp to define PAIRP itself but please import
a new version of whatever package had been broken as soon as possible. Thanks.
